name: Vocational and higher education providers
what: Register as a training organisation or higher education provider with the national regulators (or a state regulator), and register on CRICOS to enrol overseas students.

layers.who: State VET regulator (some providers in Victoria and Western Australia)

basis.quote: Registered training organisations (RTOs) must comply with the VET Quality Framework laws.
Businesses that enrol overseas students must follow the Education Services for Overseas Students (ESOS) Framework laws.

issues.what: Universities and training providers faced overlapping Commonwealth and state quality requirements and poorly coordinated regulators.

evidence.source: Annual Review of Regulatory Burdens on Business: Social and Economic Infrastructure Services
evidence.quote: overlap between Commonwealth and state/territory responsibilities and requirements, including quality assurance activities, and a lack of coordination by regulators across jurisdictions

issues.status_note: Reported in 2009 and not rechecked. Registration has since moved largely to national regulators (see who does what).
